audit_gcp.summary: 13 APIs, 2 data resources, 10 secrets, Pub/Sub, Cloud Tasks, Cloud Run, SQL, IAM, and scheduler presence all reported OK; hard failures 0, soft warnings 0.

logging_sample.limitation: sample did not show structured userId/caseId/requestId fields

storage.evidence: active gcloud account lacks storage.buckets.get on praxis-uploads

findings.title: Latest production traffic is 100 percent latest revision, with no evidenced 5-25-100 canary phase.
findings.evidence: gcloud run services describe showed frontend and backend traffic as 100 percent latestRevision.
findings.remediationSketch: Add deploy log/canary artifact capture or move deploy automation to explicit staged traffic splits before claiming canary compliance.

findings.title: Cloud SQL production posture is ZONAL with 7-day transaction log retention, below architecture HA/PITR target.
findings.evidence: gcloud sql instances describe returned availabilityType=ZONAL and transactionLogRetentionDays=7.
findings.remediationSketch: Decide whether v1 launch requires REGIONAL HA and 30-day PITR; if yes, update instance settings through Terraform/approved cloud change.

findings.title: Observed operational scheduler jobs are paused.
findings.evidence: gcloud scheduler jobs list showed praxis-check-alerts, praxis-generate-briefing, and gdelt-poller in PAUSED state.
findings.remediationSketch: Confirm intentional pause versus launch blocker; enable or document runbook gating before production-readiness claims.

findings.title: Cloud Storage bucket versioning/public-access/lifecycle posture could not be verified with current credentials.
findings.evidence: gcloud storage buckets describe gs://praxis-uploads failed with storage.buckets.get denied.
findings.remediationSketch: Grant read-only storage metadata access to the audit principal or capture bucket policy in Terraform/audit docs.

findings.title: Cloud Logging trace ids are present, but structured userId/caseId/requestId coverage is not proven.
findings.evidence: latest frontend log sample included trace ids only; requested latest 100 backend log structured-field proof was not completed in this phase.
findings.remediationSketch: Add an observability audit that samples Cloud Logging for traceId, spanId, userId, caseId, and requestId on critical routes.

notes: Terraform drift was not run because no Terraform root/state was identified during this local audit slice.
